name: Filippo Arena
bornNote: BORN AND BAPTISED THE SAME DAY at Scilla -- «infantem HODIE NATUM» -- and given the name PHILIPPUS NUNTIATUS. The extract was copied from the parish book of baptisms on 26 May 1815 for his own marriage file. It replaces the «c. 1794» this archive carried from his statement at his son's birth registration in 1819, where he gave his age as twenty-five; he was twenty-six.
father: Orazio Arena (b. c. 1751)
source: Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186; Matrimoni 1851 atto 13; Nati 1861 atto 228; Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186 read in the processetti of 1851
note: Named in FOUR independent acts. The sea trade runs Orazio -> Filippo -> Francesco Antonio -> Rocco, four generations of sailors, and he was a MARINARO himself at twenty-two. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. HE WAS ALSO, FOR FIVE DAYS, THE ARCHIVE'S PUBLISHED WALL -- «his marriage to Domenica Costa is pre-civil, the Arena line stops here» -- because this archive believed Scilla's registers began in 1816. THEY BEGIN IN 1809. He married Domenica Costa on 12 NOVEMBER 1815, Matrimoni atto 29, and the act names his parents ORAZIO ARENA and LITTERIA MORABITO, both alive and both standing beside him, because at twenty-two he was still a minor under the code. Every negative reported for 1816 to 1819 was correct; the conclusion drawn from them was not. AND HE COULD WRITE: he signed his own marriage act «Filippo Arena sposo», and signed his son's birth act in 1819, in registers where almost nobody signs.

name: Domenica Costa
bornNote: BORN AND BAPTISED THE SAME DAY at Scilla, by the archpriest Giuseppe Ingigneri himself, and given the name DOMINICA JOSEPHA. This settles a five-year disagreement in this archive's favour of neither guess: she was twenty-eight at her marriage in November 1815, which fits exactly, and THIRTY-TWO -- not twenty-seven -- when her son Francesco Antonio was born in November 1819. The age in that birth act is five years wrong.
father: Giovanni Costa
source: Scilla, Nati 1819, atto 186; Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186 read in the processetti of 1851
note: Filippo Arena's wife, and now one of the best-attested people in this archive: her baptism of 1787, her marriage of 1815, her son's birth in 1819. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. Her parents are GIOVANNI DE COSTA, dead at Scilla on 29 March 1790 when she was two, and MARTA ALFONZETTI, who was still alive to consent to the marriage twenty-five years later. NOTE THE SURNAME: Costa is also what her great-grandson Rocco married, in Generosa Costa, and a Lorenzo Costa was lodging with Rocco in New York in 1900. THIS ROW ONCE SAID «HER MARRIAGE IS OUT OF REACH». It was in a volume nobody had opened, four years before the window this archive had drawn for itself.

name: Francesco Antonio Arena
bornNote: Act 186 of 1819. Act 228 of 1861 makes him 42 on 23 December 1861 -- forty-two years and one month. The fit is exact.
father: Filippo Arena
source: Scilla, Nati 1819 atto 186; Nati 1860 atto 45; Nati 1861 atto 228
note: ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE, which puts Rocco Arena under Orazio Arena instead. He and Serafina Arlotta have a son Giuseppe on 5 March 1860 and a son Rocco on 20 December 1861 -- exactly the sibling pair the tree assigns to Orazio.

name: Serafina Arlotta
bornNote: Act 2 of 1830. Twenty at her marriage on 7 February 1851 -- exact. Act 228 of 1861 makes her 28, which is three years adrift; she was 31.
father: Giovanni Arlotta
source: Scilla, Nati 1830 atto 2; Matrimoni 1851 atto 13; Nati 1861 atto 228
note: ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. Her parents are now confirmed twice over: Giovanni Arlotta, marinaro, and Maria Costa.

name: Filippo Arena (the younger)
bornNote: Act 48 of 1852.
father: Francesco Antonio Arena
source: Scilla, Nati 1852, atto 48
note: Rocco Arena's eldest brother, named for their grandfather Filippo. Not in the family tree.

name: Domenica Arena
bornNote: ACT 53 of 1853 -- not act 2, which is a Tavola row number. Born at twelve o'clock on 24 March 1853 in her parents' own house and declared the same afternoon by her father.
father: Francesco Antonio Arena
source: Scilla, Nati 1853 atto 53, read in the original
note: ROCCO ARENA'S SISTER, NOT HIS BROTHER -- and this archive carried her as a son for weeks. The act says «una FEMINA», then «di dare alla FANCIULLA il nome di DOMENICA», and the baptism column names DOMENICA ARENA. Three statements in one act, none ambiguous. Her father is written out in full as FRANCESCANTONIO ARENA, thirty-two, MARINARO -- exact for a birth on 25 November 1819 -- and her mother SERAFINA ARLOTTA, twenty-two, exact for 13 June 1830. Not in the family tree. IT ALSO REMOVES A MYSTERY: a daughter who married leaves the Arena surname, so «Domenico Arena disappears after 1853» was never a disappearance.

name: Teresa Arena
bornNote: Act 6 of 1853.
father: Orazio Arena
source: Scilla, Nati 1853, atto 6
note: Orazio Arena's earliest known child. Not in the family tree -- which gives Orazio only the two children who turn out to be Francesco Antonio's.

name: Giovanni Arena (b. 1854)
bornNote: Scilla, act 76 of 1854, at nine in the morning, in his parents' house. NOT 20 April, and not the son of a Rosa Arlotta -- the annual Tavola is wrong on both counts and the act is right.
father: Francesco Antonio Arena
source: Scilla, Nati 1854, atto 76
note: ROCCO ARENA'S ELDER BROTHER. His birth act names his father ANTONIO ARENA, thirty-four -- Francesco Antonio, born 25 November 1819, is exactly thirty-four in April 1854 -- and his mother SERAFINA ARLOTTA, and it was declared by his maternal grandfather GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, who gave the boy his own name. This is the Giovanni Arena who sails in 1899 to join 'brother Rocco' and enters six-year-old Anna as his NIECE. HE IS IN THE FAMILY TREE, and this archive said for a time that he was not: the tree's Giovanni Arena, husband of Concetta Russo, IS this man, dated 1870 there and born in fact on 30 April 1854. What the act adds is sixteen years and two parents, not a person.

name: Giovanni Arlotta
bornNote: TWENTY-EIGHT at his own marriage on 30 August 1828. His daughter's birth act of 1830 makes him forty and his grandson's of 1854 makes him seventy-five -- three of his own declarations, twenty-one years apart. The marriage act is preferred: it is the one where age carried legal weight and it names his parents.
father: Domenico Arlotta
source: Scilla, Nati 1854 atto 76; Matrimoni 1851 atto 13; Nati 1830 atto 2; Scilla, Matrimoni 1828 atto 28
note: Serafina Arlotta's father, so Rocco Arena's maternal grandfather. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. A sailor. NOW IN THREE ACTS AND DATED: the marriage act of 1851, his daughter's birth act of 1830, and the birth act of 1854 in which he appears IN PERSON, aged seventy-five, to declare his grandson -- and which names HIS OWN FATHER, Domenico.

name: Maria Costa
bornNote: TWENTY-SIX at her marriage on 30 August 1828, with both her parents standing beside her and giving formal consent. CORRECTED THE SAME DAY IT WAS FIRST WRITTEN: her daughter's birth act of 1830 makes her twenty-three, which this archive entered as «c. 1807» that morning. Her own marriage act outranks her husband's statement at a registration desk.
father: Rocco Costa
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1851 atto 13; Nati 1830 atto 2; Scilla, Nati 1830 atto 89 read in the processetti of 1851; Scilla, Matrimoni 1828 atto 28
note: Giovanni Arlotta's wife. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. NOTE THE SURNAME: she is the SECOND Costa in this generation -- Filippo Arena's wife is Domenica Costa -- and their great-grandson Rocco married a THIRD, Generosa Costa. A Lorenzo Costa was also lodging with Rocco in New York in 1900. CONFIRMED TWICE, by the 1851 marriage act and the 1830 birth act.

name: Gaetano Bonanno
bornNote: AGED THIRTY-SIX at his daughter Leonarda's birth in November 1843, so born about 1807. Piedimonte Etneo.
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1843 atto 101; Matrimoni 1871 atto 14; Piedimonte Etneo, Matrimoni allegati 1871, fascicolo 14 -- «CERTIFICATO di seguita pubblicazione di matrimonio senza opposizione», 16 April 1871
note: Leonarda Bonanno's father. The archive had only the bare first name 'Gaetano', from a marriage proclamation of 1910; he is now in two registers with his surname, his trade and his age. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. ALIVE ON 16 APRIL 1871: «figlia del VIVENTE GAETANO, professione bracciante, residente anche ivi», in his daughter Leonarda's publication certificate. Aged about sixty-four and still at Piedimonte.

name: Anna Cavallaro
bornNote: AGED THIRTY-EIGHT at Leonarda's birth in November 1843, so born about 1805.
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1843 atto 101; Matrimoni 1871 atto 14; Piedimonte Etneo, Matrimoni allegati 1871, fascicolo 14 -- «CERTIFICATO di seguita pubblicazione di matrimonio senza opposizione», 16 April 1871
note: Gaetano Bonanno's wife, named in the register. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE -- and mind the namesake: the tree does hold an Anna Cavallaro, but she is the daughter of a Luciano Cavallaro BORN IN 1945 and has nothing to do with this woman, who was having children in the 1830s. Two different people, a century and a half apart. ALIVE ON 16 APRIL 1871: «e della VIVENTE ANNA CAVALLARO, professione industriosa, residente anche ivi». First record of her trade, and a proof of life twenty-eight years after Leonarda's birth.

name: Domenico Arlotta
bornNote: Not sought. Scilla's civil registration begins in 1809, so his birth is pre-civil and would be a parish record.
source: Scilla, Nati 1854, atto 76
note: THE DEEPEST PERSON THIS ARCHIVE HAS REACHED ON THE CALABRIAN SIDE. Named only as 'il fu Domenico' in his son Giovanni Arlotta's own words, in the birth act of his great-grandson Giovanni Arena, 30 April 1854. A great-great-great-great-great-grandfather of the two children. ENTIRELY ABSENT FROM THE FAMILY TREE. TIGHTENED BY TWENTY-SIX YEARS: he is «FU Domenico Arlotta» in his son's marriage act of 30 AUGUST 1828, so dead before then, not merely before April 1854. AND HE HAS A WIFE NOW: ANNA BARBARO, who was alive at that wedding.

name: Concetta Russo
bornNote: Aged TWENTY-SIX at her marriage in October 1885, so born about 1859. Scilla.
father: Leonardo Russo
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1885, atto 86
note: GIOVANNI ARENA'S WIFE. IN THE FAMILY TREE, which gives her no dates and no parents; the register gives both. Her age of thirty-three in her son Giuseppe's birth act of October 1892 puts her birth about 1859, and the same act names her parents LEONARDO RUSSO and ANGELA BAGNATO -- and those two are genuinely absent from the tree.

name: Leonardo Russo
bornNote: Not sought.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1885, atto 86
note: Concetta Russo's father, living at Scilla in 1885. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Angela Bagnato
bornNote: Not sought.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1885, atto 86
note: Concetta Russo's mother, living at Scilla in 1885. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Maria Martello
bornNote: Aged TWENTY-FOUR at her marriage in September 1885.
father: Paolo Martello
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1885, atto 73
note: Giuseppe Arena's wife -- Giuseppe being Rocco Arena's brother, born 5 March 1860. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. Her father PAOLO MARTELLO was already RESIDENT IN AMERICA in 1885.

name: Anna Arlotta
bornNote: Not yet sought.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1888, atto 63
note: Generosa Costa's mother, named for the first time. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. AND NOTE THE SURNAME: Rocco Arena's mother is Serafina ARLOTTA and his wife's mother is Anna ARLOTTA. Whether they were sisters has not been tested, but if they were, Rocco and Generosa were first cousins.

name: Fortunato Arena
bornNote: Ten days old when he died on 1 October 1891, so born about the 21st of September. Via Grotte 70, Scilla.
father: Giovanni Arena
source: Scilla, Morti 1891, atto 134
note: A son of ROCCO ARENA'S BROTHER Giovanni, dead at ten days. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. His death act fixes the household at VIA GROTTE -- the same street where his brother Giuseppe would be born thirteen months later, at number 75 -- and calls his father a PESCATORE, as Giuseppe's birth act does.

name: Antonio Costa
bornNote: AGED FORTY-EIGHT at his daughter Generosa's banns in November 1888, so born about 1840.
source: Scilla, Pubblicazioni 1888 no. 63; Matrimoni 1888 atto 63
note: Generosa Costa's father, now dated and with a trade. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Maria Donato
bornNote: Twenty-eight months old when she died on 16 February 1891, so born about October 1888. Via Grotte 21, Scilla.
father: Michele Donato
source: Scilla, Morti 1891, atto 22
note: A daughter of MICHELE DONATO and MARIA SOFI, and a sister of Nunziata Donato, dead at two years and four months. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. Her death act gives her father's trade -- PESCATORE -- and the family's address.

name: Francesco Giovanni Rocco Arena
bornNote: Ten months old when he died on 30 June 1898, so born about August 1897. Via Acquagrande 30, Scilla.
father: Giuseppe Arena
source: Scilla, Morti 1898, atto 91
note: A NEPHEW OF ROCCO ARENA -- son of his brother Giuseppe and Maria Martello -- dead at ten months. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE. His three given names are his paternal grandfather and both his uncles: FRANCESCO for Francesco Antonio Arena, GIOVANNI and ROCCO for his father's brothers.

name: Domenico Donato
bornNote: EXACT, from his own birth act copied into his marriage bundle — Scilla, Nati 1816, atto 207, declared by his father the day he was born. It agrees to the day with the thirty-eight he is given at his son Michele's birth on 3 October 1855.
father: Candeloro Donato
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129); Matrimoni 1844 atto 20; Nati 1855 atto 163
note: MICHELE DONATO'S FATHER, and a great-great-grandfather of the two children. A sailor, like the Arena men. HE IS IN THE FAMILY TREE as Michele's father and nothing more -- no dates, no trade, no parents. This archive claimed for a time that he was absent; that was wrong. What is new is everything else about him: born about 1817, MARINARO, and son of CANDELORO DONATO and MARIA PALADINO, who are absent.

name: Nunziata Sofi
bornNote: From her own birth act copied into her marriage bundle — Scilla, Nati 1818, atto 129. Agrees with the thirty-seven she is given at her son's birth in October 1855.
father: Pasquale Sofi
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129)
note: MICHELE DONATO'S MOTHER. IN THE FAMILY TREE, under the fuller form ANNUNZIATA SOFI, with no dates and no parents. Her son married a SOFI in his turn -- Maria Sofi -- and named his daughter NUNZIATA for her. What the 1844 Tavola adds is her parents, PASQUALE SOFI and MARIA DE AMICO, who are absent.

name: Candeloro Donato
bornNote: THIRTY-THREE when he declared his son Domenico's birth on 18 December 1816, so born about 1783. The first age this archive has ever had for him.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129); Matrimoni 1845, atto 31
note: THE OLDEST DONATO, and now dated. A sailor, like his son and his grandson. He was alive when his son Michele married in August 1845 -- «FIGLIO DI Candeloro Donato», not «del fu» -- and alive the year before too: his son Domenico's marriage bundle of July 1844 runs to FIVE FOGLI and contains no death certificate for either father, which this series required when a parent had died. HE IS WHERE THE SCILLA LINE STOPS. His own marriage, and any birth of his own, fall before 1816 when Scilla's civil registration begins, and his son Michele was born at MESSINA about 1814 where registration does not begin until 1820. Everything earlier is a parish record.

name: Rocco Arlotta
bornNote: Aged twenty-two at his marriage in June 1900.
father: Antonio Arlotta
source: FindMyPast, United States Marriages; US census 1900
note: THE ARLOTTA IN ROCCO ARENA'S HOUSEHOLD in the Manhattan census of June 1900, now identified: he married ANTONIETTA TAVANI in Manhattan on 4 June that same month. His father was ANTONIO Arlotta -- NOT the Giovanni Arlotta who was Serafina's father -- so he is not her nephew; a cousin is likelier and is untested. He stayed in New York: a Rocco Arlotta baptises children at Our Lady of Loretto, the Arena's own parish, in 1905 and 1908. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE.

name: Antonino Prostamo
died: 31 December 1837, at Pizzo, in the cholera
source: Briatico, Matrimoni 1849, atto 1 — Antenati an_ua87663
note: The fourth generation, carried as UNTESTED until 14 September 2026 and now documented four times over. A MARINARO like his father and his son. He died at two in the morning on the last night of 1837 and his death is entered in Pizzo's SEPARATE REGISTER OF CHOLERA DEATHS, atto 327 — which is why the ordinary Morti volumes do not hold him. IN THE FAMILY TREE as antonino-prostamo-1785, where he is dated 1785 and given Pasquale Prostamo and a «Caterina Di Meio» as parents; the Pizzo register calls that same wife CATERINA MAJO.

name: Caterina Cichello
bornNote: TWENTY-SIX at her marriage on 2 March 1824, and BORN AT ZAMBRONE — so born about 1798, which agrees with the about-1799 this archive already had from her daughter's marriage bundle.
father: Francesco Cichello
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1824, atto 2; Briatico, Matrimoni 1849, atto 1
note: GIOVANNA VENTRICE'S MOTHER, and now with parents. She married GIUSEPPE VENTRICE at ZAMBRONE on 2 MARCH 1824, and the act names her «figlia DEL FU FRANCESCO e DELLA FU VITTORIA MOLLO» -- both already dead when she married at twenty-six. She was widowed in June 1831, eighteen years before she appears alive at Briatico in her daughter's marriage papers of 1849.

name: Caterina Majo
source: Pizzo, Morti 1829, atto 7 — Antenati an_ua37926878
note: Pasquale Prostamo's wife, named because he is recorded as her WIDOWER; dead by January 1829. The family tree has no wife for the third generation. THIS ARCHIVE FIRST PUBLISHED HER AS «CATERINA MUSO». That was a misreading: the surname is MAJO in the original register and in the chancery's own certified copy of 1849, compared side by side.

name: Maria Fragalà
source: Pizzo, Nati 1814, atto 285; Pizzo morti colerici 1837, atto 327; Briatico, Matrimoni 1849, atto 1
note: Twenty-seven when her son was born in April 1814, so born about 1787. WIDOWED BY THE CHOLERA on the last night of 1837 and still living at Pizzo in June 1849, when her son married eleven kilometres away at Briatico. SHE IS IN THE FAMILY TREE, dated 1789 and married to Antonino Prostamo; this archive said for a time that she was not in it at all, which was wrong and is corrected here. What the Briatico act of 1849 adds is her widowhood, her town and her age.

name: Domenico Ventrice
father: Paolo Ventrice
source: Zambrone, Morti 1815, atto 40 — certified extract in Briatico, Matrimoni processetti 1849-1854
note: Giovanna Ventrice's paternal grandfather, and the reason his certificate is in her marriage bundle: the act says she produced «la fede di morte del padre e dell'avo paterno», and the bundle holds exactly two Ventrice deaths. Died at Zambrone on 13 January 1815 at twenty-three o'clock, a BRACCIALE, husband of ANNA FAMA, and son of the late PAOLO VENTRICE and the late ANNA PAPPA. HIS AGE IS AMBIGUOUS IN THE ONLY SURVIVING TEXT: the copyist writes «sposo di Anna Fama di anni cinquanta ... di anni cinquantotto, di professione bracciale». The fifty-eight sits with his trade and is taken as his, so born about 1757; the fifty is taken as his wife's. This archive first published him as fifty.

name: Anna Fama
source: Zambrone, Morti 1815, atto 40; Briatico, Morti 1839, atto 12
note: Domenico Ventrice's wife and Giuseppe Ventrice's mother. Given as «di anni cinquanta» in her husband's death act of January 1815 — on the reading that the first of that act's two ages is hers.

name: Paolo Ventrice
source: Zambrone, Morti 1815, atto 40 — certified extract in Briatico, Matrimoni processetti 1849-1854
note: The deepest name on the bride's side, reached because his son's death act calls him «il fu Paolo». Husband of ANNA PAPPA.

name: Anna Pappa
source: Zambrone, Morti 1815, atto 40
note: Paolo Ventrice's wife, already dead when their son Domenico died in 1815.

name: Giuseppe Ventrice
bornNote: THIRTY-FOUR at his marriage on 2 March 1824, so born about 1790 -- AND BORN AT S. COSTANTINO, not Zambrone, which is the first birthplace this archive has had for him. HIS TWO DECLARED AGES DISAGREE: thirty-four in March 1824 gives 1790, and thirty-three in June 1828 gives 1795. Both are his own statements. The earlier one is preferred here only because it is the earlier one.
father: Domenico Ventrice
source: Zambrone, Matrimoni 1824, atto 2; Briatico, Nati 1828; Briatico, Morti 1831, atto 12
note: Giovanna's father, and he died TWO DAYS BEFORE HER THIRD BIRTHDAY. Act 12 of Briatico Morti 1831, read in the original: dead at two in the morning on 21 June 1831 in his own house, «di anni TRENTA», declared by Giacomo Comerci, a miller, and Rosario Zungri, a bracciale. THE YEAR CORRECTS THIS ARCHIVE: the certified copy in the marriage bundle was read as 1839 and published that way; the original says 1831 and the rest of the 1839 register agrees it cannot be. HIS AGE IS STILL IN DISPUTE — thirty at death (born c. 1801) against the thirty-three he gave for HIMSELF when he registered Giovanna's birth in June 1828 (born c. 1795). The archive carries his own declaration and keeps the other on the record. HE MARRIED AT ZAMBRONE ON 2 MARCH 1824, a contadino of thirty-four born at S. COSTANTINO, and the act calls him «figlio DEL FU DOMENICO e DELLA FU ANNA MAROPOLI» -- so BOTH HIS PARENTS WERE DEAD by then, which dates his mother's death for the first time. On the surname MAROPOLI against this archive's ANNA FAMA, see the corrections page.

name: Francesco Crupi
source: Queensland death registrations 1973/B/38514, 1961/B/45635, 1982/52783, 1989/57278
note: ANGELA CRUPI'S FATHER. Named only because his children's Queensland death registrations name him -- and as of today there are FOUR of them, not one. Angela (d. 1973), PIETRO (d. 1961), ANTONINO (d. 1982) and MARIO (d. 1989) all register the same two parents, FRANCESCO CRUPI and MARIA VECCHIO. A whole Sicilian sibling group in Brisbane, of which this archive knew one. Not in the family tree.

name: Maria Vecchio
source: Queensland death registrations 1973/B/38514, 1961/B/45635, 1982/52783, 1989/57278
note: ANGELA CRUPI'S MOTHER, and named in FOUR of her children's Queensland death registrations -- Angela's, Pietro's, Antonino's and Mario's. Not in the family tree.

name: Candeloro Donato (b. 1847)
bornNote: Aged twenty-seven at his marriage on 11 December 1874. Scilla.
father: Domenico Donato
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1874, atto 62
note: MICHELE DONATO'S ELDER BROTHER, and named for the grandfather who has his own row above, and new to this archive. Married DOMENICA ROMANO, 21, a spinner, at Scilla on 11 December 1874. He was a sailor like his father, and unmarried before it. His existence is what the naming custom predicted: Domenico Donato was «figlio di Candeloro», so his first son should be a Candeloro, and here he is.

name: Domenica Romano
bornNote: Aged twenty-one at her marriage in December 1874. Scilla.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1874, atto 62
note: Candeloro Donato's wife. Not in the family tree.

name: Marta Paladino
bornNote: THIRTY when her son Domenico was born in December 1816.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129); Matrimoni 1844, Tavola entry 17; Matrimoni 1845, atto 31
note: CANDELORO DONATO'S WIFE. HER GIVEN NAME IS IN DISPUTE AND THE DISPUTE IS WORTH KEEPING. Her son's birth act of 18 December 1816, written while she was in the next room, reads «e da MAR-TA PALADINO, di anni trenta, sua moglie legittima» -- the name broken across a line, and the second line beginning plainly «ta». The 1844 marriage Tavola calls her «Paladino MARIA». The act is contemporaneous and primary and the Tavola is an index made up at the year's end, and THIS VERY INDEX SERIES HAS ALREADY BEEN CAUGHT GIVING A MOTHER THE WRONG NAME -- the 1854 Tavola calls Serafina Arlotta «Rosa», and that error briefly made a brother into a cousin. Against that: the same 1844 Tavola gets the OTHER mother in the same entry exactly right, «de Amico Maria», as her own daughter's birth act confirms. So the index is not uniformly careless. MARTA is published here because the act says it; MARIA is recorded because the index says it. Another child of Candeloro in the Scilla births of 1810-1830 would settle it.

name: Pasquale Sofi
bornNote: THIRTY-EIGHT when he declared his daughter Nunziata's birth in November 1818.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129)
note: NUNZIATA SOFI'S FATHER, and a sailor like the Donato men he married into. Alive in July 1844: his daughter's marriage bundle holds no death certificate for him. Not in the family tree.

name: Maria de Amico
bornNote: TWENTY-FIVE when her daughter Nunziata was born in November 1818.
source: Scilla, Matrimoni processetti 1842-1845, fascicolo 20 (Nati 1816 atto 207; Nati 1818 atto 129); Matrimoni 1844, Tavola entry 17
note: Nunziata Sofi's mother. Not in the family tree. HER NAME IS CONFIRMED TWICE, by her daughter's birth act of 1818 and by the 1844 Tavola independently, which is why the Tavola's reading of the OTHER mother in the same entry is a question rather than a verdict -- see [[Marta Paladino]]. NOTE A COINCIDENCE, NOT A JOIN: the Michele Donato of act 31 of 1845 married an ANGELA DE AMICO. De Amico is common at Scilla and nothing yet connects the two women.

name: Michele Donato (b. Messina, c. 1814)
bornNote: Thirty-one at his marriage in August 1845, and the act says NATO IN MESSINA — the only member of this family so far recorded as born across the strait, in Sicily rather than Calabria.
father: Candeloro Donato
source: Scilla, Matrimoni 1845, atto 31
note: DOMENICO DONATO'S ELDER BROTHER, and NOT THE MICHELE DONATO OF THIS ARCHIVE'S SPINE. Two men of the name stand three feet apart in these records: this one, born about 1814 at Messina, and his nephew born at Scilla on 3 October 1855 and named for him. Keep them apart. His act is what dates the grandfather — «FIGLIO DI Candeloro Donato», not «del fu», so CANDELORO WAS STILL ALIVE in August 1845 — and it is his mother's surname, PALADINO, that the 1844 Tavola then matched to make the brothers brothers.

name: Angela de Amico

bornNote: Not sought; 1720s, and pre-civil.

NOTE THE SURNAME: the priest who heard her son's last confession on his deathbed was REV. D. PAOLO TURCO. In a town of this size that is very likely a relative at the bedside, not a coincidence, though nothing here proves it. Not in the family tree.

name: Mariano Mazza (b. c. 1809)
bornNote: THIRTY-SIX when he declared his son Rosario's birth on 2 June 1845 -- his own statement, in person, at the comune house.
father: Ignazio Mazza (or Orazio; father of Mariano, b. c. 1809)
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1845 atto 64; Piedimonte Etneo, Matrimoni allegati 1871, fascicolo 14 -- «CERTIFICATO di seguita pubblicazione di matrimonio senza opposizione», 16 April 1871
note: THE TOP OF THE SICILIAN SPINE, AND HE HAS BEEN FILED ON THE WRONG MAN. His son's birth act names him in his own words; his son is entered as «Rosario Mazza DI MARIANO» in the 1873 birth of Salvatore and again in the 1871 marriage. THE NAMESAKE TRAP, AND THIS ARCHIVE WALKED INTO IT: the family tree holds a «Mariano Mazza» who is the son of the ORAZIO MAZZA BORN 1883, himself a son of Rosario -- a twentieth-century man who cannot have fathered a boy in 1845. The 1845 record was attached to that slug and sat on his person page until 20 September. He is filed here as «Mariano Mazza (b. c. 1809)» so no parent link can ever resolve to the wrong one. Not in the family tree. ALIVE ON 16 APRIL 1871, AND THE DOCUMENT SAYS SO IN A PRINTED FIELD. The publication certificate for his son Rosario's marriage reads «figlio del VIVENTE MARIANO, professione bracciante, residente anche ivi» -- not the absence of a «fu» but the positive word, written into a form that has a blank for exactly this. He was about sixty-two, still a bracciante, still living at Piedimonte Etneo. TWENTY-SIX YEARS AFTER his own appearance at the comune house to declare Rosario's birth, and the second document in which he speaks for himself rather than being named by a descendant. 11 NOV 2026 -- HIS PARENTS, HIS WIFE'S NAME, HIS DEATH, AND HIS OTHER CHILDREN. (1) Piedimonte Etneo Matrimoni 1836 atto 17 (8 September 1836): «Mariano Mazza, 30, son of Ignazio and Giuseppa Pulvirenti (70)» marries AGATA CATALANO, 27, daughter of the late Carlo Catalano and Maria Cardillo. (2) Piedimonte Morti 1887 atto 10: Mariano Mazza died 9 February 1887 aged EIGHTY, 'fu Orazio' and 'fu Polvirenti Giuseppa', «marito di Catalano Agata». (3) Matrimoni 1860 atti 30 and 31 name Mariano Mazza and Maria Catalano as the parents of Salvatore (b. c. 1841) and Venera (b. c. 1837), whose marriages are recorded here. INFERRED, NOT PROVED: all three are tied to THIS Mariano by his name, his age (30 in 1836, 36 in 1845, 80 in 1887 -- born 1806-09), his town, and a wife surnamed Catalano; no act says in so many words that the Mariano of 1836 or 1887 is the father of Rosario. THE FATHER'S NAME DISAGREES: Ignazio in the 1836 promise act (re-zoomed, it has an n); Orazio in the 1836 table and the 1887 death act (whose declarants were gravediggers). NOT RESOLVED. THE WIFE'S NAME DISAGREES TOO: Agata in 1836 and 1887, Maria in 1845, 1860 and 1871 -- both Catalano, so most probably the same woman known by two Christian names, but not proved. UPDATE 11 NOV 2026: HE HAS A BROTHER, GIUSEPPE MAZZA (b. c. 1811, d. 8 December 1855), son of the same Orazio Mazza and Giuseppa Pulvirenti, who married Venera Catalano (daughter of Giovanni, born at Macchia) on 31 January 1836, eight months before Mariano's own wedding (Matrimoni 1836 atto 3; Morti 1855 atto 122). The father is Orazio in both brothers' records.

name: Maria Catalano
bornNote: THIRTY-SIX at her son Rosario's birth in June 1845, the same age as her husband.
father: Carlo Catalano
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1845 atto 64; Piedimonte Etneo, Matrimoni allegati 1871, fascicolo 14 -- «CERTIFICATO di seguita pubblicazione di matrimonio senza opposizione», 16 April 1871
note: ROSARIO MAZZA'S MOTHER, named in his birth act of 2 June 1845 and nowhere in the family tree. The parish of the CHIESA MAGGIORE returned the baptism notice the same day. She and Mariano were both thirty-six, so both born about 1809 -- which puts their marriage in the window the Piedimonte MATRIMONI PROCESSETTI cover from 1841, a series this archive has never opened. ALIVE ON 16 APRIL 1871: «e della VIVENTE MARIA CATALANO, professione industriosa, residente anche ivi». The same certificate that gives her husband. It is also the first record of her TRADE -- industriosa, the word these registers use for a woman doing piecework at home. 11 NOV 2026 -- HER PARENTS, INFERRED, NOT PROVED: the 1836 marriage act (Piedimonte Matrimoni 1836 atto 17) names the bride as AGATA Catalano, 27, born at Macchia, daughter of the late CARLO Catalano and of MARIA CARDILLO (60), and the 1887 death act of Mariano Mazza calls his widow «Catalano Agata»; every act that names her as Rosario's mother calls her MARIA. The 27 of 1836 agrees with the 36 of 1845 (born 1809) and not with the 59 of 1860. Same husband's name, same surname, same town: probable, but the two Christian names are unreconciled, and her parents are recorded here only on that inference. What would settle it: Rosario's baptism extract in his 1871 marriage file, or Matrimoni 1871 atto 14's own parents paragraph.

name: Rosario Mazza
bornNote: Act 64 of 1845: born at eleven in the morning and declared the same day. The tree says 1850; his death act of 1924 makes him seventy-nine, which agrees with the register and not with the tree.
father: Mariano Mazza (b. c. 1809)
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1845 atto 64; Matrimoni 1871 atto 14; Italy, Catania -- death 15 November 1924

This row exists only to carry the join: it anchors MARIANO MAZZA and MARIA CATALANO, both named in his own birth act, onto the export person the charts draw. Without it the chart closed his line with «Before Piedimonte Etneo, 1850» -- a card that reported the tree's silence and read as though the registers were silent too. They are not. He is the top of the Sicilian spine in the export; the two people above him are documented and the chart now draws them.

name: Mariano Mazza (b. 1872)
bornNote: Act 32 of 1872: born at ten in the evening of 12 February and declared at noon the next day by his father in person.
died: 8 March 1872 (Piedimonte Morti 1872 atto 22, strada Borgo, aged three weeks)
father: Rosario Mazza
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1872 atto 32

Rosario Mazza's first son is named for ROSARIO'S OWN FATHER -- exactly what the custom predicts -- which is a third independent pointer at Mariano Mazza (b. c. 1809) after the 1845 birth act and the «di Mariano» patronymic. Born in CONTRADA SAN BASILIO, the same lane the family is in when Salvatore is born eleven months later. ELEVEN MONTHS IS TIGHT: Salvatore was born 5 January 1873, so either this boy died in infancy or the two births are ten and a half months apart. Not in the family tree, and his death has not been sought. NOTE THE NAME: there are now THREE Mariano Mazza in this archive -- this baby, his grandfather (b. c. 1809), and the twentieth-century man in the family tree who is a son of the Orazio born 1883. All three are TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE twice over -- this baby of 1872, his grandfather born about 1809, and the tree's twentieth-century namesake -- and they are filed apart on purpose so that no father= in this file can resolve to the wrong one. DIED 8 MARCH 1872, three and a half weeks old (an_ua83445, image 12; read by a delegated reader): that settles the 'eleven months is tight' puzzle: the next child, Salvatore, was born 5 January 1873.

name: Gaetano Mazza
bornNote: Act 66 of 1880: born at half past four in the afternoon of 5 May and declared at a quarter past ten four days later by his father in person.

father: Rosario Mazza
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1880 atto 66

BASILIO -- the same lane as his brother Mariano eight years earlier, and the mother's surname is given in full, which is what tells this household apart from the other Rosario-and-Leonarda in the town. GAETANO is the name the Sicilian custom gives after the MOTHER'S FATHER, and Leonarda's father is GAETANO BONANNO, named as such in the 1872 and 1873 acts. Witnesses Dimauro Salvatore, twenty-two, and Zappala Sebastiano, twenty-four. Not in the family tree, and his death has not been sought. DIED 10 SEPTEMBER 1880, aged four months (an_ua83453, image 59; read by a delegated reader).

name: Domenico Arena (barbiere, b. c. 1743)
bornNote: SEVENTY at his son Diego's marriage on 12 August 1813, standing beside him and consenting -- so born about 1743, EARLIER THAN ANY OTHER ARENA IN THIS ARCHIVE.

He is a BARBER where the spine is four generations of sailors, and the only Arena this archive has who was alive in the 1740s. His wife is ANNA MELIDONI and his eldest son DIEGO ARENA, sartore, married Maria Giuseppa Pontillo in 1813. HE IS NOT CLAIMED AS ORAZIO ARENA'S FATHER, and the temptation to claim him is the reason this note exists: Scilla has more than one Arena family, and TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE sharing a surname in one small town is how this archive nearly hung a birth act on the wrong Mariano Mazza a week ago. What would settle it is Orazio Arena's own marriage, which is pre-1809 and parish.

name: Anna Melidoni
bornNote: FIFTY-FOUR at her son Diego's marriage in August 1813.

Like her husband she belongs to an Arena household this archive cannot yet connect to its own -- TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Arena of the spine until something says otherwise.

name: Diego Arena

NOTE THE BRIDE'S SURNAMES: Pontillo and Idone both appear elsewhere in this archive, in the Polistena and Costa households. That is a coincidence of common Scilla names and is written down as one.

name: Carlo Arena
bornNote: Not sought; pre-1809 and therefore parish.

TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Arena of this archive's spine until a record says otherwise -- the napoleonic marriage years hold Domenico the barber, Carlo, and Orazio, three Arena fathers with nothing between them.

name: Antonia Arena
bornNote: Not sought; pre-1809 and therefore parish.

name: Giuseppe Arena (b. c. 1794)
bornNote: TWENTY-SEVEN on 7 November 1821, at his own solenne promessa -- so born about 1794.

NOTE THE NAME: the family tree holds a GIUSEPPE ARENA born 1860, son of Francesco Antonio -- TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE two generations apart, and the later one is named for this one, which is what the naming custom predicts.

bornNote: Not sought; pre-1809 and therefore parish.

Two women of the name, or a clerk's eye slipping up a line. The Tavola is preferred here only because it does not repeat itself, and the doubt is recorded rather than hidden. TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from Litteria Morabito either way: one was alive that day and one was not.

EITHER TWO SISTERS MARRIED TWO BROTHERS, OR ONE WIDOW MARRIED HER BROTHER-IN-LAW. Nothing read so far settles it; the Scilla death registers of 1821-1838 would. bornNote: Not sought; pre-1809 and therefore parish.

The 1833 entry writes «fu Santo», so he was dead by then; the 1821 entry's father's name is cut by the page edge and this is what supplies it. NO CONNECTION TO ORAZIO ARENA IS CLAIMED -- Scilla holds at least seven Arena households in this period.

name: Filippo Arena (the elder, d. before 1830)

AND HE EXPLAINS A NAME: Orazio's first son, born 25 March 1793, is FILIPPO -- the Sicilian and Calabrian custom giving the first son his father's father. This archive used the custom to RANK candidates for four months and never once to identify one; here the act confirms it after the fact, which is the only way round that is safe. THERE ARE NOW THREE FILIPPO ARENA in this archive: this one, his grandson born 1793, and that man's grandson born 1852. All three are filed apart on purpose.

TWO DIFFERENT PEOPLE from the Giuseppe Arena born about 1794 who is Filippo's brother, and from the Giuseppe Arena born 1860 who is Rocco's -- three men of the name in three generations of one extended family, which is what the naming custom does to an archive.

bornNote: Not stated.

note: HIS DEATH IS FOUND, AS AN EXTRACT, AND HIS NAME IS ORAZIO. The marriage files of his daughters Domenica (1842) and Alfia (1844) both contain the certified extract of Piedimonte Morti 1828 act 66, listed as 'atto di morte di Orazio Mazza padre della sposa': Orazio Mazza, eighty, bracciale, born at Mascali, died 8 September 1828 at 2 a.m. in the countryside of Piedimonte, son of the late Innocenzio and the late Antonia Sapienza; the extract names no wife. Both daughters' baptisms (19 December 1815 and 15 December 1812) name «Horatius Mazza» and Josepha Pulvirenti, so Orazio, not Ignazio, is the father's name in the church books; the 1836 promise's 'Ignazio' is therefore the misreading or the slip. CAUTION: at eighty he is some thirty to forty years older than Giuseppa Pulvirenti and fathered Alfia at about sixty-four; the age may be exaggerated, or a first marriage may lie behind them. THE ACT IS NOW OPENED (12 Nov 2026, an_ua72293 image 36 left page, re-zoomed at 1600 px): act 66, 8 September 1828, 'Orazio Mazza di anni ottanta' (the surname's double z is cursive; it reads Mazza), 'nato in questo territorio' (born in THIS TERRITORY, which means Piedimonte's, NOT written Mascali: the 'Mascali' of the closing table and of the extract's earlier reading is the readers' gloss on 'Idem' and is not borne out by the act), son of the late (fu) Innocenzio and of the late Antonia Sapienza; died at 2 in the afternoon (not 2 in the morning) in the countryside of this territory; the declarants are Alessandro Buccio (50, bracciale, strada Difesa) and Gaetano Cassaniti (40, vettaniere), who cannot write; the sindaco Domenico Vacy? signs; no wife is named. His birth has not been opened: if Mascali, the Bourbon registers there begin in 1820 and he is earlier, so the baptism is a parish record. THE 1828 REGISTER'S CLOSING TABLE (Morti 1828 row 66, an_ua72293 image 53, re-zoomed) lists «Mazza [?]razio, Idem (Mascali), Mazza Innocenzio, 8 September» with the first letter under an ink blot; an earlier reading of the blot as Ignazio is not borne out by the zoom, which shows the letters -razio, and the extract spells it Orazio. HIS CHILDREN, AS NOW READ: Mariano (b. c. 1809), Giuseppe (c. 1811), Alfia (1812), Domenica (1815), Innocenzio (d. 1876, aged 'eighty') and Rosa (c. 1819), by Giuseppa Pulvirenti; Innocenzio's mother is written ANGELA Pulvirenti.

Morti 1843 atto 60 (an_ua72308, image 33, left page; the act's text was re-zoomed by the session): on 25 December 1843 at eight in the morning died at Piedimonte «Giuseppa Pulvirenti, di anni se[ssan]ta, moglie di fu Orazio Mazza, nata in Piedimonte, filandiera, figlia di fu Mariano e di fu Agata Barbagallo»; declarants Mastro Orazio Cardile (muratore) and Francesco Morabito (bracciale). note: MARIANO MAZZA'S BROTHER, PROVED BY HIS DEATH ACT.
